apiCapability.appUninstall: Takes no arguments and uninstalls the CALLING app (the connector). Never call it. No Admin API mutation uninstalls another app.
apiCapability.webPixelDelete: Only deletes the calling app's own web pixel. Custom pixels (Customer events) have no Admin API object.
apiCapability.channelDelete / publicationDelete: channelDelete only deletes channels created with channelCreate by the calling app. Not a way to remove another app's sales channel.
apiCapability.consentPolicyUpdate: Exists: consentPolicyUpdate(consentPolicies: [{countryCode, regionCode, consentRequired, dataSaleOptOutRequired}]). Requires write_privacy_settings, which the connector doesn't have, so it isn't usable today. It also sets the regional policy only; turning the banner on is a separate Admin setting.
apiCapability.privacyFeaturesDisable: Exists (COOKIE_BANNER, DATA_SALE_OPT_OUT_PAGE, PRIVACY_POLICY) but only disables; there is no enable mutation.
apiCapability.checkoutAndAccountsConfigurationUpdate: Branding and overrides only. No marketing opt-in or sign-in fields.
